name: sobremesa
description: Sobremesa: juegos de mesa multijugador en games.samuelciocan.com

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter sobremesa-logic build && pnpm --parallel --recursive run dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter sobremesa-logic build && pnpm --filter sobremesa-server build && pnpm --filter sobremesa-client build
scripts.format: prettier --ignore-path .gitignore --write apps packages tests scripts playwright.config.ts README.md docs package.json docker-compose.yml eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --ignore-path .gitignore --check apps packages tests scripts playwright.config.ts README.md docs package.json docker-compose.yml eslint.config.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm test:i18n && pnpm test:client && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e
